project.name: Few-rotor transfer: planar bound and 3D controls
project.subtitle: Six representative planar-pair ratios sample the exact pendulum bound and its numerical check. Three-dimensional zero-angular-momentum controls use seed 1701 across a triangle, open four-rotor chain and four-rotor ring at seven couplings. The common chart parameter is initial packet energy divided by coupling; series keep rotor count, topology and preparation separate.

runs.description: Few-rotor transfer: planar bound and 3D controls

parameters.control_type: aligned planar pair; one initially resting rotor

assessment.summary: Six representative planar-pair ratios sample the exact pendulum bound and its numerical check. Three-dimensional zero-angular-momentum controls use seed 1701 across a triangle, open four-rotor chain and four-rotor ring at seven couplings. The common chart parameter is initial packet energy divided by coupling; series keep rotor count, topology and preparation separate.
assessment.recordedStudyStatus: 14 planar-pair runs and 63 three-dimensional runs; six half-step controls, a symmetric-triangle control, and scalar-ODE/conservation checks recorded
